keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match (Parma). VAR checking.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Abdoulaye Ndiaye (Parma) is shown the red card.
David Romero (Parma) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Nicolò Casale (Bologna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury David Romero (Parma).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Parma. El Bilal Touré replaces David Romero because of an injury.
Substitution, Bologna. Samuel Mbangula replaces Juan Miranda because of an injury.
Mariano Troilo (Parma) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Parma. Sascha Britschgi replaces Benjamín Cremaschi.
Substitution, Parma. Nesta Elphege replaces Simone Lontani.
Substitution, Bologna. Riccardo Orsolini replaces Nadir Zortea.
Goal! Parma 0, Bologna 1. Arthur Theate (Bologna) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Nicolò Cambiaghi with a cross following a fast break.
Substitution, Bologna. Eivind Helland replaces Nicolò Casale.
Substitution, Bologna. Roberto Piccoli replaces Jens Odgaard.
Enrico Delprato (Parma) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Parma 0, Bologna 2. Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Bologna. Martin Vitík replaces Nicolò Cambiaghi.
Martin Vitík (Bologna) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Parma 1, Bologna 2. Vincent Sierro (Parma) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Parma. Pontus Almqvist replaces Giovanni Fabbian.
Substitution, Parma. Christian Ordóñez replaces Vincent Sierro.
